title: Exchange local machine policy must require signed scripts.
check_content:
Open the Exchange Management Shell and enter the following command:

Get-ExecutionPolicy

If the value returned is not "RemoteSigned", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Open the Exchange Management Shell and enter the following command:

Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned
VulnDiscussion: Scripts often provide a way for attackers to infiltrate a system, especially scripts downloaded from untrusted locations. By setting machine policy to prevent unauthorized script executions, unanticipated system impacts can be avoided. Failure to allow only signed remote scripts reduces the attack vector vulnerabilities from unsigned remote scripts.
